mapper.select: select candidate.biz_date from batch.business_calendar c cross join lateral ( select (#{bizDate}::date - day_offset)::date as biz_date from generate_series(1, 366) as offsets(day_offset) ) candidate left join lateral ( select h.day_type from batch.calendar_holiday h where h.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and h.biz_date = candidate.biz_date and ( (h.scope = 'CALENDAR' and h.calendar_id = c.id) or (h.scope = 'GROUP' and h.group_code = c.group_code) ) order by case h.scope when 'CALENDAR' then 0 else 1 end limit 1 ) day_rule on true where c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and c.enabled = true and ( day_rule.day_type = 'WORKDAY_OVERRIDE' or ( day_rule.day_type is null and extract(isodow from candidate.biz_date) between 1 and 5 ) ) order by candidate.biz_date desc limit 1
